description: TikTok Creative Center hashtag chart — real videoCount/totalPlays, plus rankDiff and trend[] on that path. Flat 2 credits. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh. Envelope includes cached + cachedAt on hits.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country for the Creative Center chart. Default US.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 100). Flat 2 credits per call.

newOnBoard.description: Only hashtags newly on the Top 100.

query.description: Optional niche seed for legacy co-occurrence + challenge/detail enrich. Omit, or pass trending, to use the Creative Center chart. A chart miss is 502 — trending is not treated as a niche seed.

name: tiktok_popular_hashtags
title: TikTok Popular Hashtags
